title: src/world structural debt: import cycles, exception-driven legality, anonymous errors
body:
Structural debt in src/world that no single fix addresses:
- 12 import cycles (madge), 10 of them through overworld.ts -> quest_launch.ts.
- Legality decided by catching exceptions in liveJobChoices/liveEventChoices (session.ts ~3219-3297).
- 891 anonymous "throw new Error" with no error subclass, so callers match on message text.
- chooseJourneyStoryInternal is ~420 lines (session.ts ~2173-2593); session.ts is 4,036 lines.
- The six opening journal modules are near-copies (~2,000 lines).
- The 12-quest campaign order is hard-coded in TypeScript (journey_campaign.ts ~13, 20, 977).
Related open items: 6bac01f8 (dead exports), ffc570b2 (wolf_winter coupling in core), 339f5089 (split the world JSON), 8e3375cd (dedupe the quest bridge).

Audit report: https://claude.ai/artifact/SD45nGH1YqftoSvkxL8Hbb (2026-09-22, main c17192f9).
